rationale: B is better because it defines a clearer immutable artifact graph, captures the exact grader input and output, verifies hashes on read, and gives a concrete reconstruction path from metrics to every relevant artifact. A has a serious identity inconsistency: its shared generation blob embeds a run_id while excluding run_id from the content hash, so deduplicating identical generations across runs leaves the blob pointing to only one run and breaks its claimed eval→generation→run reconstruction. B has minor operational gaps—Parquet should be partitioned or rewritten rather than directly appended, and run manifests are append-only but not themselves content-addressed—but its overall provenance and regrading design is more sound and auditable.
